verdict.rationale: Brex lets admins define spend, documentation and approval rules that run automatically on every transaction: out-of-policy purchases are blocked, multi-level approvals are routed by amount, vendor or role, and a review agent auto-approves low-risk items. Arbitrary event-to-action automation, however, needs webhooks plus external tools such as Zapier, Workato or Pipedream. Missing for 10: a native general-purpose rule/trigger builder beyond spend-policy and approval presets, detailed docs on rule configuration and which events can trigger actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
